output.subject: Tool for your readers: termdiff — side-by-side git diffs in the terminal, 38ms on 10k lines
output.pitch:
Hi,

Your readers live in the terminal. Most of them still squint at git's default pager for code review.

termdiff replaces that pager with a true side-by-side, word-level diff view — no config, no GUI, no new workflow. Drop a single static binary in place of your existing core.pager setting and it just works.

The benchmark in the README: a 10,000-line diff renders in 38ms on an M1 MacBook Air. It's MIT-licensed, packaged in Homebrew core, and sitting at 4,200 GitHub stars after its first year.

The audience that would care most: senior engineers on monorepos and OSS maintainers who review diffs many times a day. Exactly the Console.dev reader.
